Method of Attack: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain RCE by migrating a maliciously crafted JWT request to a server that verifies the request.
If the payload on the request was slightly different, it would be practical for remote code execution to take place in the same way.
Impacted Systems: Over 22,000 open-source projects using the JsonWebToken library
Systems that use version 8.5.1 or earlier of JsonWebToken
Attack Vector: JWT request with a specially crafted object to perform arbitrary file writes on the target machine
Exploiting the verify() method without authentication checks
